#!/bin/bash

SRC_CKPT=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints

mkdir -p $MODEL_DIR

  SHARD=$(printf "model-%05d-of-00006.safetensors" $i)
  echo "Starting shard $SHARD..."
  scp -P $SCP_PORT ${WESTD}:${SRC_MODEL}/${SHARD} ${MODEL_DIR}/${SHARD} &

  echo "Starting adapter OLMo-2-7B_${dosage}_s42..."
  scp -P $SCP_PORT -r ${WESTD}:${SRC_CKPT}/OLMo-2-7B_${dosage}_s42 ${CKPT_BASE}/ &
done

wait
echo "=== Parallel SCP DONE $(date) ==="

echo "--- Adapters ---"
for dosage in d000 d005 d025; do

df -h /root/autodl-tmp/
SCRIPT
